# Reading Companion for *Asymptotic Statistics* {.unnumbered}

This is an unofficial reading companion to A. W. van der Vaart's *Asymptotic Statistics*. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by van der Vaart or Cambridge University Press & Assessment.

The companion is designed to be used alongside the original text, not in place of it. Readers will need a lawfully obtained copy of the book for the assigned readings, complete context, and end-of-chapter exercises. The publisher's edition is available through [Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/asymptotic-statistics/A3C7DAD3F7E66A1FA60E9C8FE132EE1D).

## Path to Chapter 25 {#route-to-chapter-25}

The direct path used here follows the two prerequisite routes shown in Figure 0.1 of van der Vaart's preface:

$$
2\longrightarrow6\longrightarrow7\longrightarrow8\longrightarrow25,
\qquad
2\longrightarrow18\longrightarrow19\longrightarrow25.
$$

## Seven-week reading plan

- Week 1: [Chapter 2: Stochastic Convergence](chapter-2.qmd)
- Week 2: Continue [Chapter 2](chapter-2.qmd), including little $o$/big $O$ notation; [Chapter 6: Contiguity](chapter-6.qmd)
- Week 3: [Chapter 7: Local Asymptotic Normality](chapter-7.qmd)
- Week 4: Continue Chapter 7 through Theorem 7.12; [Chapter 8: Efficiency of Estimators](chapter-8.qmd)
- Week 5:
  - Briefly continue [the convolution theorem in Chapter 8](chapter-8.qmd#sec-convolution-theorem)
  - [Chapter 18: Stochastic Convergence in Metric Spaces](chapter-18.qmd)
  - [Chapter 19: Empirical Processes](chapter-19.qmd), through Donsker classes
- Week 6: [Chapter 25: Semiparametric Models](chapter-25.qmd), part 1
- Week 7: [Chapter 25: Semiparametric Models](chapter-25.qmd), part 2
